dogecoin.text: @David89315838 @dogecoin_rise @elonmusk Dodgecoin symbol is spelt:  DOGE Click on it and you can buy it at the current price (market order) or choose the price you want to buy it at (limit order).  I like the VOYAGER app because you can set the price you want to buy it at if it reaches that strike price (buying level).

@David89315838 @dogecoin_rise @elonmusk Download Voyager app on phone.  Enter in promo code in all caps:  bile9d to give us both $25 bonus when $100 or more purchased.  Link your bank account to app.  And purchase from there
